notes.title: "Spider Queen Cave" - The Nightmare of Heroes
notes.content:
"Spider Queen Cave" boasts an exhilarating storyline that gradually unravels the dark secrets of the Spider Queen. Immersive visuals transport you into a hair-raising underground world, while puzzle-solving and hidden object challenges will test your intellect and insight. Simultaneously, spine-tingling sound effects and music promise a heart-pounding journey.

Purchase "Spider Queen Cave" now, heroes! Seize this limited-time opportunity to begin your terrifying adventure at a discounted price. But beware, once you step into the lair, you might not return. Do you have the courage to face the ultimate nightmare? Don't miss this heart-pounding expedition; hurry and buy "Spider Queen Cave" to start your exploration!

notes.title: This update solves most of the problems and improves game fluency! ! !
notes.content:
[b] Elevator added to Abyss level[/b]
Because some players reported that the level of the organ road is too difficult, we added an elevator at the bottom of the organ road, and the elevator will appear after a certain number of deaths. This elevator takes you directly to the last part.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500516/45034fa17afbfedf18d7e51f02e7805265e4bd76.png[/img]
Due to the lack of resources in the cave, the elevator is relatively small, and the elevator can only be entered by kneeling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500516/ea2ade325d12ffd38015d5805b500e5b364559b1.png[/img]
When taking the elevator, you can enjoy the scenery outside through the translucent elevator, which is better than the experience of taking the scenic cable car.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500516/62946cda48192b667d5ddcea020a6287a37a03d7.png[/img]
[b] The process optimization of the senior sister's home[/b]
1. The process of burning things is optimized. You don't need to open the backpack and click. You only need to have the item in your backpack and it will be used automatically.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500516/44d9fd9d41460600fbb08ad29a7e3df3350edaa8.png[/img]
2.After reaching a certain number of deaths, more gasoline and wood will be refreshed in the scene, and you will no longer be afraid of looking for wood to run away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500516/27307721551f0d7eb400d58c506ad0d0e5f33c54.png[/img]
3. Some props will be given when restarting after a certain number of deaths, instead of starting from 0.
4.If there are too many deaths, all props will be moved to the basement for you.
[b] Add two ways to clear the ending, and you can clear the game in 3 minutes at the fastest.[/b]
I won't go into details on this, you can explore by yourself.
[b] Several complex puzzles have added hints[/b]
Once you start solving the puzzle, hints are given at regular intervals as time goes by.
[b] Beautification of blood bar in Boss battle[/b]
